notes: The Basewiser B is now the browser tab icon - the brand mark on a card tile matching the portal design, crisp from pinned tabs up to full-size bookmarks. If your tab still shows the old icon, a hard refresh clears the cached one.

The Basewiser B is now the browser tab icon - the brand mark on a card tile matching the portal design, crisp from pinned tabs up to full-size bookmarks. If your tab still shows the old icon, a hard refresh clears the cached one.

The inbox is rebuilt for triage: every incident is its own card with sortable columns (severity, tenant, owner, age), an incident category on each row (Privilege escalation, Policy guard, Identity hygiene, Operations), and a quick-actions menu - assign to me, take over, open the customer, copy the link - without opening the case.

Filters speak one language everywhere: multi-select pills with built-in search and one-click clear on the Inbox, Customers, Identity health and Conditional Access pages. Filter to two tenants and a category in three clicks; the X on the pill undoes it in one.

The Customers list gains search and sortable columns - sort by Alerts for the what's-on-fire view - and secondary tab rows across the portal are now full-width segmented strips, with the Identity tab reclaiming the space the old side table-of-contents held.

Role-grant alerts no longer reference an allowlist - there is no role allowlist; severity is purely tier-driven (GA above Tier 0, other roles lower). The change allowlist keeps governing guard-mode alerts, where it belongs.

Granter resolution is now three layers deep: the admin's own audit footprint resolves instantly, PIM schedule requests confirm intent (activation vs admin grant), and granter-less rows backfill for 24 hours - the WHO tile updates itself with a journal note.
Findings move with events: a role grant triggers the tenant's identity rescan immediately, and the active-alert badge updates the moment an incident is resolved.
